scenes.say: Nobody can see your talent. They can only see your signals. Harsh, but true.
Signaling theory: when quality is hidden, people rely on signals that are expensive to fake.
The chain: quality is hidden, the good ones pay for a costly signal, the bad ones can't copy it, so it's believed.
A signal only works if it's expensive for people who don't have the real thing.
Degrees, long warranties, fancy offices can all be signals. The question is who they're expensive for.
When reading a signal, ask: would this be hard to fake without the real quality?
